state_write is const. It selects logical source rows using rs_idx*size+(cell.src or cell index), including the pending rollback plane. Saving/getting size does not clear rs_idx or materialize a base-plane restore.

state_read removes the destination sequence, installs the serialized logical payload into the destination/base row, sets each cell.src to its new cell id, then resets rs_idx to0. A get+set roundtrip canonicalizes pending rollback, changing the path of the next decode.

Actual next decode fills the shared I32 s_copy input by s_copy(), which consumes/resets pending rs_idx and supplies the selected rollback-plane row to build_rs/get_rows. This is the path the uninterrupted rejection branch must exercise.
The recurrent memory_update implementation reports NO_UPDATE. Do not describe state save/synchronize or generic memory_update as a special rollback flush.

Hybrid seq_rm checks recurrent removal first, then KV. flagsPARTIAL_ONLY serializes only recurrent state; flagsNONE serializes attention KV followed by recurrent state. A recurrent-only restore is not a complete branch checkpoint.

Despite broad legacy header wording, this implementation of full/sequence state serialization writes model architecture+memory or memory, not host pending/carry/prior, sampler chain state or the current output/logit buffers. Never read old output getters after restore as if those values were restored.

The present chain contains greedy only; greedy reset is a no-op. Keep the exact same bound GPU sampler and settings. No RNG/history is involved, but this does not generalize to repetition/top-p/stateful samplers.

payload_comparison_contract.API: For comparisons use flagsPARTIAL_ONLY=1, host buffer (not ON_DEVICE). Do not restore this partial blob into a complete branch; use full flagsNONE C for restores.
format_for_fixed_Qwen_only: Read and validate magic u32=0xaf143cd8, serialized seq_id i32, cell_count u32. For single seq0 expect one active recurrent cell.
For each cell read pos i32,n_seq_id u32; in seq-specific export n_seq_id must0. Metadata validates logical position but is excluded from float metrics.
Read s_trans u32 (must0) and n_layer u32 (must24). Recurrent layers are the fixed18 indices with il%4!=3. Do not infer all24 have payload.
For each recurrent layer, R: type_i i32, row_bytes u64, then cell_count*row_bytes data. Qwen has no PLE second R row, so no P segment is expected.
Then each recurrent layer S: type_i i32,row_bytes u64,then cell_count*row_bytes data. Require exact buffer exhaustion and reject any mismatched type/extent/profile.
payload_comparison_contract.actual_data: This native Qwen model creates R and S as F32. Expected R=18432 floats (conv3*6144,73728B), S=262144 floats (16*128*128,1048576B) per recurrent layer. Derive/validate the actual serialized type/size; do not cast the whole opaque blob to floats.
payload_comparison_contract.axis_note: Use same-native per-layer flat F32 payload metrics; R is ggml ne0-fast [3,6144], S ne0-fast [128,128,16] for this profile. No cross-engine transpose/precision equivalence is claimed.
payload_comparison_contract.snapshot_scope: Serialized logical current R/S only, not all history/snapshot planes. Full KV equality is a separate optional typed comparison; header/pos equality alone proves no numerical equality.
